Hi Claire — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call (attached: vendor_setup_checklist.xlsx):

Summary:
- ZephyrBio is evaluating Redwood for an initial pilot (internal analytics team).
- Procurement signaled a preference toward a Purchase Order (PO) for pilots > $25k, but they want to confirm gating docs and timing.
- Marketplace (AWS/GCP) could be an option long-term but procurement needs clarity on billing cadence and org-level approvals.

Outstanding info we promised to share:
- Redwood W-9 and vendor onboarding checklist (attached).
- Short note on PO vs corporate card flows + expected timelines.
- Billing remit + email for PO submission.

Options (short):
1) Corporate card / card-on-file — fastest: we can invoice immediately via our payments provider; pilot can start once card is authorized. (Good for small pilots)
2) PO / Net-30 invoicing — typical enterprise flow: procurement issues PO, sends to billing@redwood.com, Redwood returns invoice; required docs: W-9, signed MSA or SOW (DocuSign link available). Typical sticker: allow 7–14 business days for initial vendor setup.
3) Marketplace purchase — if you want seat-based or metered through AWS Marketplace; onboarding time varies and may require your cloud procurement team to approve marketplace vendors.

Next steps I propose:
- Claire: confirm whether Procurement will issue a PO or proceed with a card for the pilot. If PO, please share the POC name and expected PO issuance date.
- Procurement: if you have a vendor form, please send it back; we can complete and return with our W-9.
- Naomi/Marissa: we will prepare the DocuSign SOW and Redwood W-9 once you confirm the path.

Attachments: vendor_setup_checklist.xlsx

Thanks — happy to jump on a follow-up with your procurement lead if that helps.

Thanks Claire — got the vendor form. Attaching Redwood W-9 and a short PO-instructions PDF to make the PO path as frictionless as possible. (Attachments: redwood_w9.pdf, redwood_po_instructions.pdf)

To be explicit on the options and what you should expect from Redwood: 

PO / Net-30 (recommended for auditable pilot)
- What we need from you: completed vendor form (you sent), PO referencing Redwood deal ZD-4482, billing contact, and remit address (for your internal routing).
- What we will provide: Redwood W-9, sample invoice, signed MSA/SOW via DocuSign (link below) once PO is received.
- Timeline: vendor setup with Finance + first invoice delivered within 7–14 business days after we receive the completed vendor form + PO.

Corporate card
- Good for rapid start: we can accept a company card and invoice to your card; minimal vendor setup.
- Limitations: card is less ideal for multi-month enterprise pilots where procurement requires PO trail.

Marketplace
- Viable but adds 2–4 weeks likely; requires coordination with cloud procurement and sometimes additional entitlements.

Banking / Remit
- Redwood accepts ACH and wire. For ACH remit we use Redwood Inc., Account ending in 8421 (we will send full account details over our secured billing channel after vendor validation). Please send any sensitive banking requests to billing@redwood.com.

DocuSign SOW
- If you confirm PO path, we will prep a short SOW and send it via DocuSign for countersignature. (DocuSign link placeholder: https://docusign.net/XYZ123)

Next actions (summary):
- Claire / Procurement: confirm PO issuance date or whether you prefer card. If PO, please send PO to billing@redwood.com and copy me.
- Naomi/Marissa: we will complete your vendor form (if you prefer an editable version, please let me know) and return with W-9 + sample invoice.

Thanks — I attached the Redwood W-9 and a quick PO instructions file to this reply. Happy to hop on a 15-minute call with your procurement person to complete the form if that speeds things up.
